facts.fact: The Registration of Persons Act, assented to and commenced in part on 26 March 2015, establishes the National Identification and Registration Authority as a body corporate under the minister for internal affairs and gives it the function of registering births and deaths (section 5(1)(d)); the excerpt held names no civil registration system.
facts.system: registration of births and deaths (no system named)

systems.tiers: a national register of all persons in Uganda; registration centres designated by the Authority under section 58

systems.system: incorporation of information from other government databases into the register

note: An excerpt: the held text stops in Part II (section 14), before Part V on births and deaths. One governance fact, about the registering authority; nothing on how a birth or death is recorded or at which offices.
